name: Two GitHub Actions put the check and the plan on a pull request
summary: A team runs archboard check in its own CI through the check Action, which turns each finding into an annotation on the diff, and the pull-request Action posts the plan, the pictures before and after, and the footprint in one comment.

value.name: Check Action
value.responsibility: In a team's CI, installs the published CLI, runs archboard check, and turns each finding into an annotation on the diff and a job summary
value.description: A composite GitHub Action that runs TypeScript directly on Node.js. It registers the extra checkouts named in its repos input, so a binding into an infrastructure repository reads in CI. A finding with configured-path evidence gets an annotation on both ends, the code and the manifest, each with an excerpt. The fail-on and allow-codes inputs decide which findings fail the job. A check that cannot run fails the job in every case.

value.label: installs the CLI from npm and runs archboard check

value.name: Pull-request Action
value.responsibility: Posts one comment on a pull request with its proposal, the architecture before and after as SVG, and the modules whose code changed inside and outside the plan
value.description: A composite GitHub Action. It finds the proposal from its state input, the archboard-pr marker in the description, or the only draft. It renders the base and the head, commits the SVGs to the orphan branch archboard-assets so that GitHub shows them, and updates one sticky comment on each push. The footprint compares the head with the base branch. With out-of-plan set to fail, a module changed outside the plan fails the job unless the override label is on the pull request.

value.label: installs the CLI and runs render and footprint
